facts.name: Butterfly Weed
facts.notes: A monarch host plant with blazing orange flowers. Deep taproot, so plant it once and don't move it. Late to emerge in spring.

sources.title: Michigan Wildflower Farm: Dryland species list
sources.note: Michigan seed grower; marks any species that is not native to Michigan.

sources.title: UW-Madison Extension: Butterflyweed
sources.note: Slow to emerge late in spring; best to wait until spring to cut foliage; deep taproot means it may not transplant well.

companions.why: Combine with Penstemon 'Husker Red' or purple speedwells; works well with coreopsis, purple coneflower, blazing star, black-eyed Susan, little bluestem and prairie dropseed.
